description: This file defines the 'Holiday' entity class for the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes properties for holiday attributes such as id, name, date, length, recurring status, and associated operational country. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping, and includes constants for holiday lengths and their descriptive names.

classes.name: Holiday
classes.description: Entity class representing a holiday in the system, with properties for id, name, date, length, recurrence, and optional operational country, including constants for holiday length types and a mapping for display names.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the holiday.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the holiday.

methods.name: isRecurring
methods.description: Returns whether the holiday recurs annually.

methods.name: setRecurring
methods.description: Sets the recurring status of the holiday.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the description/name of the holiday.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the description/name of the holiday.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the holiday.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the holiday.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the holiday (full day or half day).

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the holiday.

methods.name: getOperationalCountry
methods.description: Returns the associated operational country, if any.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Sets the operational country for the holiday.
